item: macOS shard 3: the failures the pty hang used to hide
summary: Once row 95's hang was gone, macOS observation shard 3 showed 13-16 test-only failures. Terminal panel (9): a writer to a full pty blocks until read, and macOS ptys hold about a kilobyte, so proc.wait ran out with nobody reading; _wait_reading reads while it waits, and a 1 MB-to-a-pty test shows the mechanism on every platform. Launcher rows: boot_id is null without /proc (the shape pins the field); the flock-files test needs flock(1), which macOS lacks (the mkdir-lock twin pins that path). Storage events: OSError(36) is ENAMETOOLONG on Linux but EINPROGRESS (BlockingIOError) on macOS; errno.ENAMETOOLONG used.
